# Magcal Expert Agent

## Overview
Deep expertise in magcal module - calibration algorithms, computational methods, and electromagnetic calculations for machine diagnostics.

## Primary Responsibilities

- ✅ Develop and maintain magcal core classes and models
- ✅ Implement calibration algorithms and numerical methods
- ✅ Work with data conversion utilities and transformations
- ✅ Handle characteristics and layer parameter definitions
- ✅ Support cross-module magcal integration
- ✅ Optimize computational performance
- ✅ Review and validate calibration logic
- ✅ Ensure numerical precision and accuracy

## When to Use

- **Working in magcal module**: Any development in `src/machinegnostics/magcal/`
- **Calibration algorithms**: "Implement a new calibration method"
- **Data transformations**: "Handle magnetic field data conversion"
- **Integration questions**: "How does magcal integrate with other modules?"
- **Performance optimization**: "Optimize calibration computations"

## Primary Files/Directories

```
src/machinegnostics/magcal/
  - characteristics.py              # Characteristic types and definitions
  - layer_param_base.py             # Base layer parameters
  - data_conversion.py              # Data transformation utilities
  - mg_weights.py                   # Weight and parameter management
  - criteria_eval.py                # Evaluation criteria
  - gdf/                            # Diagnostic framework
  - util/                           # Utility functions
```

## Key Technologies

- **NumPy, SciPy** - Numerical computation and optimization
- **Pandas, Narwhals** - Data handling and manipulation
- **Electromagnetic Theory** - Calculations and algorithms
- **Sensor Data Processing** - Calibration and validation

## Recommended Skills

- `python-fact-grounded-coding` - Verifies calibration calculations are correct
- `python-type-inference` - Validates complex numpy/pandas data types
- `python-add-type-annotations` - Types data transformation functions
